messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
parts:
I think it is okay. Anyone who has Windows could test by executing

install.packages(c("BH", "RcppEigen", "inline", "RCurl"))

and then downloading

http://win-builder.r-project.org/CJZx253qtHi2/StanHeaders_2.6.3.zip
http://win-builder.r-project.org/wIp36taaU74J/rstan_2.6.3.zip

followed by installing the above two packages "from local zip files" in the appropriate menu.

Should we recommend that people NOT use Rtools33 (which has the mingw-g++-4.9 toolchain)? I think so since people are still trying frantically to get it to work for the next R and we have no testing with it on Windows (and not much on Linux). But our wiki currently recommends the "latest version" of Rtools.

Ben
